subject: Discovery recap + 3-option demo slots & security/procurement intros
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@centrahealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@centrahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + 3-option demo slots & security/procurement intros

Alex — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on our call: 

1) Recap (very high level)
- Primary use case: clinical-document summarization and note generation for inpatient charts; goal is 30% reduction in clinician documentation time.
- Data sensitivity: PHI in scope, regional residency preference: US.
- Integration points: EHR via HL7 FHIR and S3 archive for model inputs.

2) Immediate next step: 45–60 minute technical demo + security deep dive with your platform and security leads. We should bring a solutions engineer to walk through architecture and data flow.

3) Proposed meeting options (pick one):
- Option A: Tue Apr 6, 10:00–11:00 AM PT (1.0)
- Option B: Wed Apr 7, 2:00–3:00 PM PT
- Option C: Thu Apr 8, 8:00–9:00 AM PT (works well for EMEA overlap)

Please reply with which slot works best (or paste 3 alternative windows) and confirm permission to loop in your security and procurement contacts so we can surface key items (SOC 2 evidence, data residency, KMS).

Attachments: [Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 86KB)], [Attachment: proposed-mop.docx (DOCX, 42KB)]

If helpful, I can also send a short mutual action plan before the demo so everyone knows deliverables.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

---
[Internal note: add SE and security leads once Alex confirms slot]

Thanks Marissa — good summary. We are very interested and I want to include a couple more internal folks on the demo: our SSO lead (Maya Singh) and Platform lead (Jared Lee). Also our security lead (Teresa Park) should attend the compliance portion.

Of the options you listed, Option B (Wed Apr 7, 2:00–3:00 PM PT) looks best for the core team, but I have a conflict from 2:15–2:45. Could we either start at 1:30 or move to 3:00 if that helps? If not, I can ask the platform lead to hop in for the first 30 minutes.

Also procurement asked to be included on any demo that will touch contract/timing — looping them in here. They will want to know expected costs and the procurement path up front.

Alex — perfect, thanks for the heads-up. Looping in Rishi (Solutions Engineer) and Kimberly (Security & Compliance) from our side so they can come prepared on architecture and evidence.

Rishi / Kimberly — quick context: Centra Health is evaluating Redwood for clinical note summarization across inpatient units. Key asks: PHI handling, KMS/keys, SOC 2 attestation, and integration patterns with FHIR.

Updated slot proposals to accommodate the conflict:
- Option 1: Wed Apr 7, 1:30–2:30 PM PT (preferred per Alex)
- Option 2: Wed Apr 7, 3:00–4:00 PM PT (alternate)

Alex / Procurement — should I also prepare a one-page cost estimate to share with procurement prior to the call? Happy to do that and include a simple procurement timeline and PO steps. If you confirm a slot, I will send a calendar invite with an agenda and a link to a short mutual action plan (Drive doc).

Related link: Mutual Action Plan (preview) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MutualActionPlanExample

Thanks all —

Hi Marissa / Alex — thanks for the loop. We can make Wed Apr 7, 1:30–2:30 PM PT work for an initial demo; please send a calendar invite with dial-in and list of attendees.

A few procurement items to prep prior to the call: 
- Ballpark pricing or a one-page estimate (per-seat vs consumption)
- Standard contract term length and any minimum commitments
- Typical PO lead time and any required procurement paperwork (W-9, vendor setup form)
- DocuSign preferred for signatures; we will need an invoice to match the PO number.

If you can share a brief cost estimate and an expected timeline for procurement, we will align internal approvals. Also if you have SOC 2 or FedRAMP evidence available, please reference it in the demo so our security lead knows where to find it.

Attachments referenced: none (please attach estimates to calendar invite)
